subject: Resourcing stress-tests & commitment windows — kickoff
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Analytics <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Resourcing stress-tests & commitment windows — kickoff

Team —

Kicking off a focused planning thread to run resourcing "stress-tests" against our FY28 compute and hiring commitments and to set clear commitment windows for Dedicated/Private capacity. Goal is to produce two artefacts by the end of week 2: a scenario playbook (best / base / stress) and a commitment calendar with financing/contract asks.

Key asks this kickoff:
- Owners: please confirm owner for each line in Q2_planning_inputs.xlsx (attached) by EOD Tue 25 May.
- Deliverables: scenario_playbook_v1 (structure: demand curve, headcount delta, cost delta, fallback toggles).
- Timeline: initial scenario drafts due Fri 28 May; finance ask package by Tue 1 Jun; leadership decision window week of 7 Jun.
- Data inputs: compute-day traces, conversion-driven traffic growth, cost-per-GPU estimates. Link to sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-plan-inputs

Specific asks for each of you:
- Vivek: run a 3x stress (100% traffic growth) and a 0.6x contraction scenario across our top-10 customers and provide GPU-day deltas.
- Laura: outline the procurement lead-times and earliest possible commitment windows for Dedicated pools; note any approval gating points.
- Aditya: map product milestones that cannot tolerate >200ms p50 increase and label critical flows.
- Marissa: surface hiring flexibility and reprioritization options that would materially reduce GPU-days.

Attachments: Q2_planning_inputs.xlsx (sheet tabs: product-metrics, infra-usage, hiring-assumptions).

We should treat this as sensitive — procurement and finance will need redlines if we move fast. Acme, including procurement here to be aware of timing and potential contract ramp.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Head of Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resourcing stress-tests & commitment windows — kickoff

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 09:05 AM Monica Patel wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Kicking off a focused planning thread to run resourcing "stress-tests" ...

Thanks Monica — I can take the 3x/0.6x workload sweeps. I'll start with top-10 by spend and also include a tail-sample for our open-source traffic surface. Deliverables:
- GPU-day delta table (per model family)
- Latency P50/P95 sensitivity under batching changes
- A short fallback recipe (quantization toggles, policy-based throttles)

I'll attach a first-pass scenario template (scenario_playbook_v1.pdf) to this thread — it's a rough skeleton but should speed alignment.

Two timeline notes:
1) For Dedicated commitments, procurement lead-time varies by region — Laura, can you confirm if EU procurement still needs 6–8 weeks for contract review?
2) If we include private on-prem in our ask it will likely add a separate approval path (security/compliance).

I'll update the sheet with the initial GPU-day rows by Mon 24 May COB.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: scenario_playbook_v1.pdf (12 pages; template: scenarios, triggers, fallback-actions)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Greenfield Capital Finance <financeops@greenfieldcap.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resourcing stress-tests & commitment windows — kickoff

Monica / Vivek —

Quick finance/procurement constraints to call out:
- Procurement: EU still averages 6 weeks for contract review; US marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) can shorten hardware lease lead-time but require an early procurement ticket.
- Commitments: Finance prefers 3-tier asks (safe, conditional, stretch) rather than a single hard commitment. We should aim to present those three ask levels with explicit covenant language for ramp-down clauses.
- Capital impact: if we push Dedicated capacity earlier than Q4 we need to model 3 scenarios of payment timing (upfront, monthly, blended) — impacts operating cash.

Related: I've opened PLAN-321 and added a procurement checklist (see https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAN-321).

Action items for this thread:
- Monica: confirm decision window you want leadership to sign off in week of 7 Jun so Finance can align cashflow modeling.
- Vivek: label which of your scenarios require multi-region procurement (adds time).
- Marissa: estimate how many FTE-months we can flex for each scenario without exceeding agreed hiring caps.

I'll coordinate with Greenfield Finance on preferred covenant templates; copied them for visibility.

Laura Bennett
SVP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resourcing stress-tests & commitment windows — kickoff

Thanks —

Read the asks. Quick decisions from product/strategy side:
- We can sign up to a two-tier commitment approach: base + contingent stretch (triggered by defined traffic thresholds). That gives Finance the triangular asks Laura requested.
- Critical flows: search, chat completions for enterprise customers and embeddings batch jobs for indexing are non-negotiable; mark these in the scenario_playbook_v1 under "latency intolerant".
- Marissa: please surface the concrete hiring deltas (FTE-months) against each scenario by Wed 26 May so we can see trade-offs.

I'll be available for a short leadership sync on Fri 28 May to lock the scenarios before the finance packaging.

-Aditya Rao
Chief Product Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference
